successCriteria.description: The policy module's public entry point (src/modules/policy/index.ts) exports a `createPolicyService` binding alongside its existing exports.

`createPolicyService()` returns an object satisfying `IPolicyService` (src/modules/policy/policy.service.interface.ts) whose construction wires `PolicyService` with `PgLeavePolicyRepository` and `LeaveTypeService(new PgLeaveTypeRepository())`.
`npm run build` completes cleanly with no TypeScript or compilation errors.
No module other than the policy module is modified in this phase (balance and leave modules remain untouched).

constraints: The `PolicyService` class, its constructor signature, and its runtime behaviour must not change.
The factory must construct `PolicyService` with `PgLeavePolicyRepository` and `LeaveTypeService(new PgLeaveTypeRepository())` — no other dependency wiring.
The policy -> leave-type dependency is the only cross-module dependency introduced; it must match the architecture's dependency map.
All existing exports in src/modules/policy/index.ts must be preserved.
outOfScope: Rewiring balance/leave modules to consume createPolicyService (deferred to Phases 2 and 3).
Any change to PolicyService business logic, validation, or repository behaviour.
Introducing dependency injection containers or new composition patterns beyond the single factory function.

entityInvariants.invariant: Every invocation returns a fresh, fully-wired IPolicyService instance (no shared/singleton state).
Constructor signature and all method behaviour remain identical to the pre-phase implementation.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: None — pure composition factory, no auth boundary.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: No runtime errors expected; construction must not throw under normal conditions.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The factory's return type must be the existing `IPolicyService` interface.
The factory must reuse `PgLeavePolicyRepository` exactly as exported by the policy repository module.
The factory must reuse `LeaveTypeService` and `PgLeaveTypeRepository` exactly as exported by the leave-type public entry point.
The policy -> leave-type dependency must conform to the dependency map in the architecture document.

integrationPoints.why: Supplies LeaveTypeService and PgLeaveTypeRepository consumed by the factory.
Supplies PgLeavePolicyRepository consumed by the factory.
